summary: Add explicit 'Verification Strategy' guidance: for local test runs/reproduction in worktrees, start narrow (use check-work skill or targeted pytest -k / specific files, not full suites), warn user before long runs (>5-10min), cross-ref long-running and CI Diagnosis protocols. Update persona and AGENTS.md with examples.
migration_impact: Agents will now use more efficient verification (targeted runs, skills first), warn on long operations, reducing wasted compute and improving user visibility. No template changes; updates to guidance/persona apply to plate persona users.
agent_notes: When asked to verify changes, reproduce failure, or run tests in worktree: prefer check-work skill or minimal targeted command (from CI log or -k), warn if expected >5-10min, use background+polling per long-running protocol if needed. See new section in quiet_operations guidance. (Addresses #523.)
